jobs.label: Staff Accountant
jobs.text:
Staff Accountant
We are looking for a Staff Accountant to manage accounts payable, month-end close and reconciliations.
Requirements: 3+ years of accounting experience, QuickBooks, Microsoft Excel, GAAP knowledge.
Nice to have: SAP, CPA.

jobs.label: HR Generalist
jobs.text:
HR Generalist
Join our people team to run payroll, onboarding and employee relations for a 300-person company.
Requirements: 2+ years in HR, payroll processing, HRIS experience, knowledge of employment law and benefits administration.
Nice to have: recruiting experience, SHRM certification.

jobs.label: Sous Chef
jobs.text:
Sous Chef
Busy restaurant seeks a Sous Chef to lead the line, plan menus and manage kitchen staff.
Requirements: 4+ years of kitchen experience, food safety certification, menu planning, inventory control.
Nice to have: catering experience, culinary degree.

resumes.label: Line cook resume
resumes.text: Experienced line cook and sous chef with 6 years in busy restaurant kitchens. Food safety certified (ServSafe). Skilled in menu planning, inventory control, ordering, and managing a kitchen staff of 8. Prepared banquets and catering events for up to 300 guests.

resumes.label: Data analyst resume
resumes.text: Data analyst with 4 years of experience building dashboards in Tableau and Power BI. Strong SQL and Python (pandas), Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP). Built weekly sales reports and forecasting models for a retail chain.
